name: CNWL World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's own top belt; the fed's closing retrospective recounts Rally Jackson winning it from Dan Johnson at the fed's own founding card (31 May 1998) and Guru's own defense of it in a bloody chair-shot brawl at the fed's Battlezone '98 closing special.

name: CNWL Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Contested in a steel-cage spot at the fed's own founding card (31 May 1998), where interference from a rival fed's own wrestlers cost Stylz the match and let Attrition claim it.

name: CNWL Million Dollar Championship
epitaph: Changed hands from Axe to Polar Bear at the fed's own founding card (31 May 1998), per the fed's own closing retrospective.

name: CNWL Extreme Championship
epitaph: Defended by Tower of Power against BJ Mullinax in a no-DQ table match at the fed's own founding card (31 May 1998), per the fed's own closing retrospective.

name: CNWL Cruiserweight Championship
epitaph: Won by "Sexy" Simon Pretswell in a ladder match at the fed's own Lord of the Ring '98 pay-per-view, per the fed's own closing retrospective.
